differences.aspect: judge-supplied random API and repeated app execution
differences.native: LeetCode calls rand10() once per request and supplies the hidden global rand7() random API.
differences.app: solve(rand7_values, draws) defines rand7() over an authored deterministic cyclic stream, defines the same single-result rand10() rejection sampler, and calls it for the requested number of outputs.
differences.rationale: The offline runner must expose hidden randomness as reproducible case data and return a finite trace for validation. Each app rand10() call executes the same two-oracle-call cell construction, rejection condition, output mapping, and expected constant work as the native method.
